articles.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
articles.snippet: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

articles.title: The election changes Washington. The work on crypto continues
articles.snippet: The next Congress inherits an unfinished assignment: establishing clear, lasting rules for digital assets that protect consumers and ensure American innovation continues to thrive, writes Blockchain Association's Lindsay Fraser.

articles.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike: Part 1
articles.snippet: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

articles.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
articles.snippet: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.

articles.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
articles.snippet: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.
